questions.question: The pivot on which the wheel of commerce rotates is
questions.explanation: Trade is the exchange of goods and services and is central to commerce.

questions.question: A distinguishing characteristic of labour is that it is
questions.explanation: Labour is geographically and occupationally mobile, unlike land.

questions.question: Land as a factor of production does not vary in
questions.explanation: The total natural supply of land is fixed, although its quality and uses vary.

questions.question: Which of the following services does a lawyer render?
questions.explanation: A lawyer provides a professional service directly to clients.

questions.question: The partner that only contributes part of the capital used in the formation and running of a business is known as
questions.explanation: A dormant or sleeping partner contributes capital but does not participate actively in management.

questions.question: One major advantage of a credit and thrift cooperative is that
options: it can approach government for a loan
each member has a vote during meetings
questions.explanation: Credit and thrift cooperatives mobilise members' savings and provide credit.

questions.question: A form of ownership which exploits the strengths of one partner to remedy the weaknesses of the other is a
questions.explanation: A joint venture combines the complementary capabilities of parties undertaking a common business project.

questions.question: At the collapse of a business enterprise, the person appointed to dispose of the assets is called
questions.explanation: A liquidator realises the company's assets and settles claims during winding up.

questions.question: Entrusting the management of a company to the courts to enable the settlement of the company's obligations is an indication of
questions.explanation: Court-supervised winding up of a company to discharge its obligations is liquidation.

questions.question: The financial instrument for borrowing in which collateral is usually more than the amount borrowed is
questions.explanation: A mortgage bond is secured by pledged property, whose value ordinarily exceeds the debt it secures.
